_comment: Light tunables. field: read by core/world/light_engine.gd (the per-tile light the rules and the picture share). view: read by the view only (view/light_sources.gd, view/world_lights.gd, the shaders through WorldView).

field._comment: sky_covered_step: level sunlight loses per tile once it has left the open column (a cell with nothing opaque above it), sideways or down under cover; the first step out of the open column costs LightEngine.STEP like any other light, so a cave mouth or the edge of a roof is lit a few tiles in. LightEngine.STEP is 5.

view._comment: darkvision_tiles: how far the own Darkvision draws the dark in grey (the rules' range is the species', this is the picture's); darkvision_grey: how bright. fill: the share of the light field drawn flat (unshadowed), under the sun's and lamps' real light. toon: 0 a smooth Lambert, 1 two hard bands. wrap: how far round a surface light reaches. shine: lamp and sun highlights on models (by roughness). sun: energy, color (high), low_color (near the horizon), height (how high it climbs: the up part of its direction at noon, front fixed), front (its lean toward the camera, so the faces seen take it), least_up, shadow_reach_m (shadow distance past the camera's), shadow biases. moon: the same by night, fainter and blue. lamps: energy, attenuation (Godot's omni decay), range_k (lamp reach against the light's radius), z_tiles (how far in front of the play plane a lamp hangs, so it lights the faces seen and throws shadows on the walls behind), flicker (by tile name or carried). max_lights: lamps at once, nearest the camera. shadow_quality: off | low | high, a row of shadows: sun (on/off), sun_size (its map), lamps (the nearest this many lamps cast shadows), atlas (their map), soft, cube (cube maps, else dual paraboloid).
